title: Device message envelope
description: Envelope for every message on the authenticated /v1/device/connect WebSocket. The platform derives robot authority from the credential presented at connection time and checks robot_id against it on every message; it never trusts the envelope for identity. Payload is validated against the payload schema matching the message type. Sequence numbers increase by exactly one per message per connection; the first message of a connection (hello) carries sequence 1. Device-to-platform WebSocket messages must be text and at most 65536 UTF-8 bytes after reassembly; violations receive malformed_message and close 4409.
